attributes.residual: 62 lines, ONE named mechanism plus its downstream colouring. MECHANISM: MWCC's front end reassociates base + i*K + C to base + (i*K + C) and discards the source's written associativity whenever the pre-offset intermediate has exactly one use - here our source ALREADY writes the target's associativity at clusters 1 and 2 (&fx[ret*240] + 2976) and MWCC still discards it. The only known carrier is a genuine READ through the pre-offset pointer before the offset step; the byte-exact positive control lives in this same TU (StartMagicHealFX reads ((EffectPage*)e)->fx[0].node between its two steps and keeps the target form). fn_80093918's target emits no such read - instruction counts are exactly 123/123 with an IDENTICAL opcode multiset, so there is no unrecovered load to supply the second use, and the carrier is provably unavailable. The remaining 56 lines are the r25/r26-vs-r22/r23 renaming downstream of the three clusters. NOT WEBFRANK-READY: the streams differ in actual instructions (add r26,r31,r0 vs add r25,r31,r25, and addi against different source registers), not in schedule or colour, so the register stage does not apply; and the add/addi pair is data-DEPENDENT in the target, so the permutation stage's independent-straight-line-atom requirement is not met either. Do not flag it. DO-NOT-RETRY the association axis without a genuinely new carrier for the pre-offset use.
